facts: Disable hibernate, idle 24 hours, expect no BMC/OS errors, hang or blue screen.
Machine time is 720 minutes, half the specified soak.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO due to physical environment and 24-hour soak.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with rollback and OOB monitoring.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify a powered-on OS remains stable while idle for 24 hours at 40 C and -5% rail margin.
must_preserve: True idle state, 24 continuous hours, margin condition and no hang/BSOD/error.
unknowns: OS idle definition, sleep settings, allowed background activity and timing metadata conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: The 720-minute conflict and positive proof of continuous OS liveness are not explicit.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep manual environmental control; use non-destructive log baselines and continuous liveness evidence for the full owner-confirmed 24 hours.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run 24-Hour Idle Soak at 40 C and -5% Rails
revision_candidate.purpose: Keep the configured OS genuinely idle and awake for 24 continuous hours under controlled margin, detecting hangs, crashes or management/platform errors.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Owner-defined OS power policy with calibrated 40 C chamber and -5% 5 V/3.3 V rails.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One configured SUT; no workload beyond approved monitoring/housekeeping.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: 24-hour versus 720-minute resolution, idle/sleep definition, allowed agents, original power-setting snapshot, liveness cadence, acceptable log events and recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Snapshot logs/settings, operator establishes margin, apply reversible no-sleep policy, record host and OOB liveness throughout the full interval, then restore exact original settings and nominal environment.
revision_candidate.preconditions: OOB path, monitoring clocks, environment calibration and rollback are proven.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Original/final power policy; continuous 24-hour uptime/liveness timeline; chamber/rail trace; OS/BMC/SEL/kernel/thermal/power deltas; no crash dump/hang; restoration evidence.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: No missing liveness interval, hang/BSOD/reboot or disallowed event during the complete 24-hour idle window.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not clear logs, confuse monitoring load with stress, accept a 12-hour run or leave hibernate settings altered.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Operator controls margin; OS owner approves power-policy change and event allowlist.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Fixture/manual observations remain human; liveness collection may be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Restore nominal rails/temperature and original power policy, preserve crash/error evidence and use OOB recovery if unresponsive.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Fixture drift, unintended sleep/reboot, liveness gap, OS/BMC/thermal/power fault or inability to restore settings.

reason_for_change: An endpoint check cannot prove a 24-hour idle soak; V3 requires a gap-free liveness timeline and exact rollback of the setting changed to prevent hibernation.
removed_ambiguities: Idle is explicitly non-stress and monitoring-bounded.
remaining_blockers: Owner must resolve duration and OS policy.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 exposes the 12-versus-24-hour mismatch and makes continuous liveness plus configuration rollback mandatory instead of relying on a final no-error snapshot.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 32 says idle 24 hours but machine time is 720 minutes and disables hibernate.
